description: Liberia-Educational Institutes is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Physical features", published or maintained by NRECA International (NRECA International). This layer contains location of educational institutes in Liberia that is collected from LISGIS to be use as base data for the analysis and mapping under Liberia NEA project. Coverage: Liberia. It has 2 files in SHP ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Physical features. The portal gives 2016 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
